Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** TWO BOATS DOCKED IN THE WATER AT THE DOGUE CREEK MARINA ON FORT BELVOIR WERE DISCOVERED SUNK TODAY SOMETIME BEFORE NOON 16FEB14. THE IRT (FORT BELVOIR FIRE DEPARTMENT) ACTIVATED THE SPCC PLAN AND RESPONDED. THEY FOUND TWO BOATS SUNK IN THE WATER. VERY LITTLE DIESEL PRODUCT WAS NOTICE. THE IOSC ESTIMATED LESS THAN A QT. MARINA OFFICIALS RESPONDED AND ARE IN PROCESS OF PUMPING OUT THE BOATS TO REFLOAT THEM BOTH. THESE BOATS ARE NOT US GOVERNMENT PROPERTY, BUT BELONG TO INDIVIDUALS UNDER CONTRACT WITH FORT BELVOIR TO DOCK THE CRAFT HERE.

Report DescriptionNOAA/NESDIS MSPR ISSUED POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 08-25-2026 REPORT TIME: 0131 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: BRETON SOUND 31 IMAGE DATE: 08-24-2026 IMAGE TIME: 1628 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 29°33'46" N/89°14'55" W AREA: 5.87 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED DARK AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND AND EXHIBITED A SHIMMERY/SILVERY APPEARANCE, INDICATIVE OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. SOME FEATHERING WAS OBSERVED TOWARD THE NORTHWESTERN SECTION. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 4.47 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.50 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE, WINDS WERE FROM THE NORTHWEST AT 13 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: A DEFINITIVE POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE IDENTIFIED, AS MULTIPLE OIL WELLS WERE LOCATED TO THE WEST, NORTHWEST, AND NORTH OF THE ANOMALY. ADDITIONALLY, THE ANOMALY WAS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 7.50 NM SOUTHEAST OF THE ANOMALY REPORTED IN NOAA/NESDIS NRC REPORT #1471655 (08/23). HOWEVER, IT WAS UNCERTAIN WHETHER THE TWO ANOMALIES WERE RELATED.
